cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Apologize Properly
cards.instruction: Get someone to deliver the apology in the form, order, and setting you consider valid.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please apologise for eating my cake at the table where it happened. I'll come with you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm sorry. There, I've said it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the table, please. Walk over before you start; I don't want half an apology in each room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your dad's sitting there. Can't we do this privately?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He heard me blame the dog. Tell him you ate it first. Then turn to me and say you're sorry.
